SELECT DISTINCT(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen ORDER BY BusinessDateSK DESC

----->Review BusinessDateSKs covered in the data.
SELECT BusinessDateSK, COUNT(*) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen GROUP BY BusinessDateSK ORDER BY BusinessDateSK DESC
SELECT BusinessDateSK, COUNT(*) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen GROUP BY BusinessDateSK ORDER BY BusinessDateSK

----->Create backup of the data.
---SELECT * INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen_bu_20230920 FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen

----->Profile the original table and the backup.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen --- 256,371,428
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen_bu_20230920 --- 256,371,428

----->Truncate the data in the table
---TRUNCATE TABLE DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen

----->Fetch the list of columns in the table. This will be used for the INSERT INTO script.
Select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen' and table_schema = 'dw'

-----> 1.) Get latest balance per account that will be inserted with BusinessDateSK = 20230601
-----> 2.) Filter data from 20210101 to 20230531
-----> Insert #1 & #2 for final data set in the FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen table


---1.) 
WITH Get_Latest_Balance_Per_Account AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AccountID ORDER BY BusinessDateSK DESC) AS RowNumber, * 
    FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen_bu_20230920 WHERE BusinessDateSK <= 20230531
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen (
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull_Original
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated_Original
    ,Currency_Original
    ,Currency_Target
    ,PesoConversionRate
    ,BalanceAmountFull
    ,BalanceAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
    20230601 AS BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull_Original
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated_Original
    ,Currency_Original
    ,Currency_Target
    ,PesoConversionRate
    ,BalanceAmountFull
    ,BalanceAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
    FROM Get_Latest_Balance_Per_Account WHERE RowNumber = 1


---2.)
WITH trim_20210101_to_20230531 AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen_bu_20230920 WHERE BusinessDateSK >= 20210101 AND BusinessDateSK <= 20230531
)
INSERT INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_PBIen (
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull_Original
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated_Original
    ,Currency_Original
    ,Currency_Target
    ,PesoConversionRate
    ,BalanceAmountFull
    ,BalanceAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull_Original
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated_Original
    ,Currency_Original
    ,Currency_Target
    ,PesoConversionRate
    ,BalanceAmountFull
    ,BalanceAmountProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
    FROM trim_20210101_to_20230531
